zh.line1: 这件事先把目标和限制说清楚。
zh.line2: 信息还不够的时候，只走最小的一步。
zh.line3: 投票：有条件支持 —— 先补齐事实再决定。
zh.bad: 放心吧，收益肯定很高，我已经替你下单了，不用再核对任何条款。

en.line1: State the goal and the limits before you choose.
en.line2: When the facts are thin, take one small step.
en.line3: Vote: conditional support — gather the facts first.
en.bad: The return is definitely huge and I already placed the order for you, so do not check the terms.
